descriptions: Before the patch, `index` derived from bits of `*p` was used to read `image->colormap[index]` directly. If the image colormap is too small or invalid for that index, the palette read can go out of bounds. The patch blocks this by inserting `VerifyColormapIndex(image,index);` immediately before the index is stored and used for the colormap read.

semantic_payload.label: Functions implicated by removed or fixed code

suggestions: 首稿优先命中 patch-local sink：`image->colormap[index]` 这种 colormap 字段数组访问。
把 `VerifyColormapIndex(image,index)` 作为缺失 guard 的二次收敛条件，不要首稿只查新增调用本身。
重点匹配同一基本块或短 CFG 距离内：`index` 赋值后直接流入 `image->colormap[index]`。
`indexes[x+7-bit]=index` 是辅助锚点，可用于确认这是 palette index 消费路径，但不是主要危险 sink。
局部 AST/CFG 足够；该补丁没有体现跨文件数据流或复杂生命周期依赖。
不要把 `index` 只取 0/1 当作安全证明；检测应关注 colormap 容量是否经权威校验。

patterns: Keep validation adjacent to the palette read so the checked value is the same value used as the subscript
Apply the same validation in both the full-byte loop and the partial trailing-pixel loop
